name: MeetMinutes
description_en:
MeetMinutes is an AI meeting capture and follow-up service positioned around Indian and mixed-language conversations. It documents calendar-linked meeting bots, recording uploads, summaries, meeting search/chat and integrations for action items. Cloud SaaS, managed enterprise and on-premises options have different commercial conditions.

The current pricing page is more specific than general multilingual claims: minutes, meeting length, language eligibility, retention and integration access all depend on the plan.
description_zh:
MeetMinutes 是面向会议记录与跟进的 AI 服务，定位重点是印度及混合语言对话。文档列有与日历关联的会议机器人、录音上传、摘要、会议搜索／问答及行动项集成。云 SaaS、托管企业版和本地部署有不同商业条件。

当前定价页比笼统多语言宣传更具体：分钟数、会议时长、语言资格、保留期限与集成权限均受套餐约束。

core_features.explanation_en: Capture documented meeting platforms or upload audio/video using the minute pool.
core_features.explanation_zh: 记录文档所列会议平台，或使用分钟池上传音视频。

core_features.explanation_en: Summary, action items and cross-meeting chat have tier-specific limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 摘要、行动项与跨会议问答各有套餐限制。

core_features.explanation_en: On-premises is listed for Enterprise, separate from cloud self-service.
core_features.explanation_zh: 本地部署列于 Enterprise，与云端自助服务分开。

en: Review mixed-language meeting summaries and action items.
zh: 核对混合语言会议摘要与行动项。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Cloud SaaS; managed/private deployment is enterprise-scoped.
Deployment.zh: 云 SaaS；托管／私有部署属于企业范围。

steps.en: Choose the calendar/platform or a permitted recording upload.
steps.zh: 选择日历／平台或获允许的录音上传。

steps.en: Confirm minutes, meeting length, languages and retention on the selected plan.
steps.zh: 确认所选套餐的分钟、会议时长、语言和保留期。

steps.en: Review decisions and speaker attribution before exporting or syncing follow-up work.
steps.zh: 导出或同步后续任务前核对决策与发言人。

items.en: The homepage documents cloud, managed enterprise and private/on-premises deployment, while the pricing comparison reserves on-premises for Enterprise. This does not establish open-source licensing or a self-service free server. Multilingual transcripts and summaries should be checked against source audio, particularly speaker changes and code mixing. For bot-entry failures, retain the permitted recording and confirm remaining minutes before uploading it. Vendor compliance and accuracy statements were not independently audited or benchmarked.
items.zh: 首页列出云端、托管企业和私有／本地部署，而套餐对照把本地部署留给 Enterprise。这不能证明有开源许可或免费的自助服务端。多语言转录与摘要应对照原音频检查，尤其是发言人切换和混合语言。机器人入会失败时，可保留获允许的录音，上传前确认剩余分钟。未独立审计或测量厂商的合规及准确率声明。

pricing.billing_basis: Plan-minute pool plus optional additional minute packs; selected multilingual annual view.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free 120 min/month and 60-min meeting cap; annual Starter ₹5,988, Pro ₹14,988, Business ₹35,988 in retrieved multilingual view; seven-day Pro/Business trials.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 每月 120 分钟，单次最长 60 分钟；读取的多语言视图年费 Starter ₹5,988、Pro ₹14,988、Business ₹35,988；Pro／Business 试用七天。

sources.title: MeetMinutes: AI Notetaking - Analyze, Transcribe & Summarize Meetings
sources.research_notes_en: India-focused positioning, capture workflow and deployment options; compliance claims treated as vendor claims.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: INR annual totals, minutes, meeting caps, retention and integrations; free-language contradiction retained.

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: From a captured meeting to checked action items
sections.title_zh: 从会议记录到经核对的行动项
sections.en: A proposed workflow connects the intended calendar or uploads a permitted recording, obtains a transcript/summary, and checks decisions and owners before sending action items to the chosen tool. Google Meet, Zoom and Teams are included in the plan comparison. The homepage also names additional platforms, so verify their exact capture route separately. Ask-across-meetings and API access are paid-tier capabilities, not assumed on a new free account.
sections.zh: 建议流程是连接目标日历或上传获允许的录音，获得转录／摘要，核对决策与负责人后再把行动项传入所选工具。套餐对照包含 Google Meet、Zoom 和 Teams。首页还提及其他平台，其具体采集方式应另行确认。跨会议问答和 API 访问属于付费档能力，不能默认新免费账户具备。

sections.title_zh: 免费分钟、时长与保留期
sections.en: Free lists 120 minutes per month, a 60-minute meeting maximum and 30-day retention. Uploaded recordings use the same monthly minute pool. Its card says multilingual minutes, but the detailed comparison marks Indian/international language access as paid; this contradiction needs vendor confirmation for any non-English free workflow. Unlimited concurrent bots does not remove the total-minute or per-meeting cap. Preserve important source recordings and reviewed notes outside a short-retention trial.
sections.zh: Free 列出每月 120 分钟、单次会议最长 60 分钟和 30 天保留期。上传录音使用相同月度分钟池。卡片写多语言分钟，但详细对照把印度／国际语言权限列为付费；非英语免费流程需向厂商确认该冲突。不限并发机器人不取消总分钟或单次时长上限。建议把重要原录音及审核笔记保留在短期试用之外。

sections.title_en: Read INR annual totals and minute pools together
sections.title_zh: 同时核对印度卢比年费与分钟池
sections.en: The retrieved multilingual INR annual view lists Starter ₹499/month billed ₹5,988/year for 400 minutes, Pro ₹1,249/month billed ₹14,988/year for 1,000 and Business ₹2,999/month billed ₹35,988/year for 2,400. Pro/Business advertise seven-day trials. Pro includes up to five team seats and webhooks/MCP; Business adds API access and unlimited seats. Extra non-expiring minute packs are sold separately, with different English/multilingual rates. Language, currency and cadence selectors can change the quote.
sections.zh: 读取到的多语言／印度卢比年度视图列出 Starter 每月 ₹499、年付 ₹5,988，含 400 分钟；Pro 每月 ₹1,249、年付 ₹14,988，含 1,000 分钟；Business 每月 ₹2,999、年付 ₹35,988，含 2,400 分钟。Pro／Business 宣传七天试用。Pro 至多五席，并开放 webhook／MCP；Business 增加 API 和不限席位。另售不失效分钟包，英语与多语言费率不同。语言、币种及账期选择器可改变报价。

research_gaps.en: Free multilingual eligibility conflicts across the pricing card and table. Transcription, bot entry, export, residency contracts and on-premises setup were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 定价卡片与对照表的免费多语言资格冲突；未测试转录、机器人入会、导出、驻留合同或本地部署。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research; original English synthesis with matching Chinese sections. Workflow examples and evaluation advice were not executed.
